text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Run in the Yasuda Kinen, then head to the Takarazuka Kinen, win, and overturn history—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Sweep Tosho presented
had completely stirred up the public.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Selfish Magical Girl Launches Her Quest for Greatness!
Did Choosing the Takarazuka Over the Arima Aim to Overturn Decades of History?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't matter if you came from the Triple Tiara route!
A strong Umamusume is simply strong!
Will this proclamation spark a whole new wave of feverish excitement!?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san... I see.
So that's where you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Then I—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? You're worried because I'm small?
Shut up, when I say I'm gonna do it, I'm gonna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Yasuda Kinen right into the Takarazuka Kinen! I'm definitely gonna win! Haven't I been telling you that?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On that day as well, Sweep Tosho made a grand, confident declaration before the press.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After all, drawing attention like this is necessary to pull off a special race—and by extension, the ultimate racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I won't let them talk about Tiara or Triple Crown anymore!
Just watch, behold my magic—!
—...I cannot let that go unheard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before her, an Umamusume appeared.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what!? Zenno Rob Roy!?
Wasn't today supposed to be a solo interview with Sweep Tosho—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, an impromptu entry?! She didn't look like the type to pull something like that off...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her knees tremble faintly, and her face is slightly pale.
She looks as though she might be crushed by her own boldness, yet—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Rob Roy.
I couldn't quite hear youâ
what did you just say?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... I said I cannot let that pass!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san.
...I shall be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Standing right there, she declared boldly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I have claimed the Autumn Shield.
Now I shall go on to win the Japan Cup, win the Arima Kinen, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I will achieve the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, unseen since the End-of-Century Overlord, and prove myself this year's Horse Girl of the Year!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And, nggh... to become the true representative
of all the Umamusume from the Triple Crown route—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Bearing the hero's sword, I will vanquish the witch at the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san. You, whom I have always looked up to...
Now is my chance to challenge you—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No. ...I will face you head-on,
and I will win!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is the heroic saga I shall weave...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
Ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahahahahah!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Well said, Rob Roy.
Thanks to that, all our preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Witch-hunting? Hah, you mean hero-slaying!
In a special race like the Takarazuka Kinen,
the extraordinary me representing the Triple Tiara will—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna race the absolute most special version of you,
and I'm gonna win!!
That's how I'll complete my ultimate magic!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this, Rob Roy.
—Even if you start moping and crying again,
I'm not gonna comfort you anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! That is just what I was hoping for...!
